title: Galois representations
description: A fifteen-lesson course on profinite Galois groups, elliptic-curve Tate modules, local Weil–Deligne representations, compatible systems and Galois representations attached to modular forms. Includes editable lesson sources, exercises with solutions and reproducible figures. The mathematical statements specify their hypotheses and the additional geometric inputs used in conditional arguments.
